headline: AI rout: VIX 35.89; Huang reinstated at Nvidia per 8-K; bounce is unverified

what_happened.summary: The Cboe Daily Take 'Market Selloff Deepens as Investors Seek Shelter' (20 Nov) says Friday looked like an escape to protection, not dip-buying. The S&P 500 and Dow closed in correction territory, the Nasdaq Composite fell 5.3%, and the Nasdaq 100 was 'dangerously close' to a bear market. Cboe says Nvidia lost nearly 14% on reports of an SEC probe into its accounting and Anthropic (ANT) lost more than 9%. Over the weekend, an NVDA 8-K (SEC filing, a primary source) says the board reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as President and CEO effective immediately. Several headlines this morning describe a futures bounce, but they are unverified and the inputs carry no live prices.
what_happened.market_action: Cboe volatility on Fri 20 Nov: VIX 35.89 (+26.20%), VXN 45.25 (+24.04%), VVIX 138.03, VIX9D 40.72 (+39.17%), COR1M 36.05 (+19.29%). SKEW fell to 138.84 (-1.43%). FRED closes only run to 19 Nov: Nasdaq-100 26517.05 (-2.21%), S&P 500 7175.83 (-2.02%). Friday's index closes are not in FRED yet. Cboe puts the Nasdaq Composite's Friday fall at 5.3% and says the S&P 500 broke below 7,000. Headlines describe futures bouncing, so a Monday rebound is possible, but Cboe cautions that a rebound would not necessarily end the correction.
what_happened.macro: Official Treasury yields on 20 Nov fell sharply: 2-year 4.63% (-13.0 bp), 10-year 4.92% (-12.0 bp), 30-year 5.31% (-9.0 bp). Cboe reads this as a flight to Treasurys. Polymarket (prediction market, not FedWatch) prices a 25 bp December hike at 92.5%, a 50+ bp hike at 2.0% and no change at 5.1%. HY OAS was 3.52 on 19 Nov (+5.0 bp), wider on every observation since 3.23 on 13 Nov. Latest BLS prints: October CPI +0.35% m/m, core +0.3%, unemployment 4.1%, payrolls +165.0k. Headlines on yields this morning conflict with each other and are unverified.
what_happened.geopolitics: Cboe's Daily Take lists unresolved Middle East conflicts and a string of technology and power outages as open risks. Oil data are stale: Brent 92.94 and WTI 89.53 as of 17 Nov. Oil headlines this morning mention Gulf tensions and supply surplus; they are unverified.
what_happened.company_news: Primary source: the NVDA 8-K (accepted 23 Nov, 13:57 UTC) reports Huang's reinstatement on 22 Nov, with Ms. Kress remaining CFO. Headlines tie it to a Trump push to rehire Huang and say Nvidia is surging pre-market; these are unverified. Cboe notes that Nvidia has erased $1.4 trillion in market cap since the 8 Nov scandal. The SEC-probe reports on Nvidia are Cboe-relayed media reports, not a confirmed filing in these inputs. AMD denied the short-seller and circular-financing allegations (Cboe, citing Barron's). ANT listed options start trading today per the Cboe options preview.

driver_reason: The AI unwind is Nvidia-centred: SEC-probe reports on Friday, then a CEO reversal in the 8-K. ANT and AMD fell in the same selloff, and the move is amplified by volatility (VIX 35.89, COR1M 36.05) and a priced December hike.
leader_reason: Nasdaq-100 minus S&P 500 was -0.19 pct pts on 19 Nov and -0.78 over five sessions, so tech has lagged, and VXN minus VIX is 9.36 pts, so Nasdaq-100 vol still carries a premium. COR1M at 36.05 shows the selling has spread beyond tech, but the AI complex is still the source of the stress (leadership facts are lagged to 19-20 Nov).

memory_update.running_thesis: Fri 20 Nov (Cboe): S&P 500 and Dow in correction, Nasdaq Composite -5.3%, Nasdaq 100 near bear territory. Nvidia fell nearly 14% on SEC accounting-probe reports and ANT fell more than 9%. VIX 35.89, VXN 45.25, COR1M 36.05, VVIX 138.03. Yields fell (10-year 4.92%) on flight to safety while Polymarket prices a 25 bp hike on 9 Dec at 92.5%. NVDA 8-K: Huang reinstated as CEO on 22 Nov. Headlines point to a Monday bounce (unverified); Cboe warns a rebound may be only a reset. HY OAS 3.52 on 19 Nov. ANT options start 23 Nov. Oil data stale to 17 Nov.
